author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
My resume has a long list of fancy technical terms, I just happened to learn those all these years. 

My core competencies are actually automation and debug.

author.name: Job K Joseph
author.headline: Director - Hi-tech | Global Presales Leader | Enterprise Strategy | CXO Advisor | Thought Leader | Insight-Led Digital Transformation /Growth Partner

comments.text: Debugging always felt so therapeutic.. makes us like Sherlock solving a crime of wayward bits and bytes... I remember my first ever US trip, the purpose was to support post silicon validation efforts. I never got tired even after a full day, and used to regularly stay back till 730pm.  The lab colleagues used to ask me, dude, where do you get so much energy?

author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

replies.text: Job K Joseph and building ad hoc debug tool to help yourself debug is another important skill

author.name: Job K Joseph
author.headline: Director - Hi-tech | Global Presales Leader | Enterprise Strategy | CXO Advisor | Thought Leader | Insight-Led Digital Transformation /Growth Partner

replies.text: Horace Chan its like having a neural network inside your brain that instinctively tells you N ways in which design errors will manifest, and hence what N lagging or leading indicators must be tracked... and hence what tool/method you need to do the job..
